title: Drone survey shows rust-like lines and cracks on the object
summary: Dennis Asberg tells of Drone survey shows rust-like lines and cracks on the object, about 2025 at Baltic Sea anomaly, between Sweden and Finland, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: We saw some weird lines. Yeah. Some cracks. Yeah. And something I would say it was like rust. Like metal.

plain: A treasure hunter named Dennis Asberg says that in 2025 his team sent an underwater drone down to the Baltic Sea anomaly, an oddly shaped object his team found on the seafloor between Sweden and Finland. Asberg says the footage showed strange lines, cracks and something that looked like rust, like metal. If true, it would hint that the object is made rather than natural.
